name: cloudconvert
description: Cloud-based file conversion platform like iLovePDF

scripts.install:all: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm start"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.render-build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install
